LF-1001.title: Little Fern Ribbed Romper in GOTS Organic Cotton
LF-1001.description: This soft ribbed romper keeps your baby comfortable through the first year. It is made from GOTS certified organic cotton, and the ribbed knit stretches as your baby moves, kicks and crawls. Press studs along the leg make nappy changes quick and easy, and the fold-over cuffs on the sleeves add a neat finish. Choose from Oat or Sage. Machine wash at 40 °C. Suitable for babies aged 0-12 months.
bullets: Made from GOTS certified organic cotton

Machine wash at 40 °C. For babies aged 0-12 months

LF-1002.title: Little Fern Muslin Swaddle, 2-pack, Organic Cotton
LF-1002.description: A light, breathable muslin swaddle for wrapping your baby at nap time and bedtime. Each pack holds two swaddles, one in Dusty Rose and one in Cloud, both made from GOTS certified organic cotton. Each one measures 120 x 120 cm, and they also work as a burp cloth or pram cover when you are out and about. Machine wash at 60 °C. Suitable for babies aged 0-6 months.

120 x 120 cm with a light, breathable weave

LF-1003.title: Little Fern Knitted Bonnet in Merino Wool
LF-1003.description: This knitted bonnet keeps your baby's head and ears warm on cooler days. It is made from merino wool, which is naturally temperature regulating, so your baby stays comfortable indoors and out. The bonnet covers the ears and ties under the chin, which helps it stay on in the pram or carrier. It comes in a warm Caramel shade. Hand wash cold and dry flat. Suitable for babies aged 3-12 months.
bullets: Soft merino wool that is naturally temperature regulating
Covers the ears
Ties under the chin
Colour: Caramel
Hand wash cold, dry flat. For babies aged 3-12 months

MP-2001.title: Moss & Pebble Wooden Stacking Rainbow, 7 Arches
MP-2001.description: This wooden stacking rainbow gives your child a toy that can be played with in many ways. Its 7 arches in graduated sizes can be stacked, lined up or used as a bridge in pretend play. Each arch is made from beech wood finished with water-based paint, and all the edges are rounded. The rainbow meets the EN 71 toy standard. Wipe clean with a damp cloth. Suitable for ages 12 months+.
bullets: 7 beech wood arches in graduated sizes
Finished with water-based paint and rounded edges
Stack, line up or build a bridge for pretend play
Meets the EN 71 toy standard
Wipe clean with a damp cloth. For ages 12 months+

MP-2002.title: Moss & Pebble Pull-Along Hedgehog in Beech Wood
MP-2002.description: This pull-along hedgehog gives new walkers a friendly companion to take along as they find their feet. It is made from beech wood, with a cotton cord and a wooden bead handle. The wheels make a gentle clicking sound as the hedgehog rolls behind your child. It supports early walking and meets the EN 71 toy standard. Wipe clean with a damp cloth. Suitable for ages 18 months+.

Wooden bead handle on the end of the cord
Wheels make a gentle clicking sound

MP-2003.title: Moss & Pebble Silicone Teether Ring, BPA-free
MP-2003.description: This teether ring gives your baby something to chew on when new teeth are coming through. It is made from food-grade silicone, is BPA-free and meets the EN 71 toy standard. The textured surface is made for sore gums, and the ring is easy for small hands to hold. You can cool it in the fridge before use. Choose Sage or Sand. It goes in the dishwasher on the top rack. Suitable for babies aged 3 months+.
bullets: Food-grade silicone, BPA-free, meets EN 71
Textured surface for sore gums
Easy for small hands to hold

NK-3001.title: Nordvik Kids Rain Jacket with Detachable Hood
NK-3001.description: This rain jacket is made for wet walks to school and puddle days at the park. It is made from recycled polyester with a PU coating, and the seams are taped. The hood is detachable, and reflective details on the back and sleeves help your child be seen on darker days. Choose from Mustard or Navy. Machine wash at 30 °C and do not tumble dry. Suitable for children aged 2-8 years.
bullets: Recycled polyester with a PU coating
Taped seams

Reflective details on the back and sleeves

NK-3002.title: Nordvik Kids Fleece Mittens in Recycled Polyester
NK-3002.description: These fleece mittens keep small hands warm on cold days outside. They are made from recycled polyester fleece, with a long cuff that stays inside the sleeve and elastic at the wrist. Each mitten has a thumb sized for small hands, so they are easy to put on before heading out to play. Choose Navy or Forest. Machine wash at 30 °C. Suitable for children aged 1-4 years.

Long cuff that stays inside the sleeve
